_description: udp_custom ARQ Reliable UDP Stream Tunnel Server Configuration (DNAT + IP_RECVORIGDSTADDR multi-path)

_fields.listen: The SINGLE UDP port the server binds, e.g. ':36712'. The firewall DNATs the whole client port range (see 'port_range') onto this one port. The server NEVER binds the range itself — it relies on origdst to recover each packet's pre-DNAT destination port and reply from it.
_fields.port_range: FIRST-CLASS server port range, e.g. '25000-26000' (host optional). The single source of truth for the client port range: the firewall DNATs this whole range onto 'listen'. Used at runtime to validate incoming origdst ports (a packet outside the range is a misconfiguration signal) and as the default --range for 'gen-nftables' / 'gen-iptables'. The server never binds these ports.
_fields.host: Public server IP / domain fed to 'gen-uri' so the generated client config knows where to dial (e.g. '1.2.3.4'). Not used at runtime by the server itself.
_fields.origdst: REQUIRED (Linux only). Enables IP_RECVORIGDSTADDR so the server recovers each client packet's original destination port (pre-DNAT) and replies FROM that exact port. Without it every reply leaves from 'listen' and any NAT stricter than full-cone drops it. Ignored on non-Linux platforms.
_fields.sendsock_max: Per-port reply-socket pool cap (LRU). One socket is bound per distinct origdst port so the kernel stamps the reply's source port correctly. Set it >= the size of 'port_range' (e.g. 1024 for a ~1000-port range) to avoid per-packet rebinding.
_fields.target: DEFAULT backend to forward traffic to (tcp://127.0.0.1:22 or udp://127.0.0.1:51820). Used when the client does not request a target in its handshake.
_fields.allowed_targets: Client-REQUESTED per-session targets are honored only when they match one of these glob patterns ('*'/'?' in host and port; network must match), e.g. 'tcp://127.0.0.1:*' or 'tcp://*.internal:22'. Empty = only the default 'target'; denied requests are silently dropped. The granted endpoint is echoed in the authenticated handshake ACK.
_fields.passwords: Required non-empty list of pre-shared keys (PSKs); protocol v2 has no unauthenticated mode (aliases: token, psk)
_fields.privkey: Noise Curve25519 static private key (generate with 'udp_custom gen-keys'). Sessions are ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted with the PSK even when empty; adding 'privkey' upgrades them to forward-secret Noise_NK keys (client must set matching 'pubkey').
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
